title: BotRecordReference v1
description: Canonical record:// reference. The parser accepts surrounding ASCII whitespace, ASCII case-insensitive scheme and authority, and leading zeros in the decimal position; both are normalized. No other spelling is accepted. The decimal position is bounded by 2^53-1 (JSON safe integer). session is 0-based DSH session-log seq; event is a 1-based bot_events commitSeq.
